question: At which of the following Dutch trading centres on the Coromandel Coast was Fort Geldria built in 1613?
explanation: Fort Geldria was built by the Dutch in 1613 at Pulicat (north of Madras). Pulicat was the principal seat of the Dutch presidency on the Coromandel Coast until they shifted their headquarters to Negapatam in 1690.

question: Which fort was established by the Dutch East India Company at their trading centre of Chinsura in Bengal in 1653?
explanation: The Dutch established a prominent factory at Chinsura (Hugli) in Bengal in 1653 and fortified it with Fort Gustavus. Fort William was British (Calcutta), Fort Geldria was Dutch (Pulicat), and Fort St. George was British (Madras).
